title: Typo in variable name uninitalized_val in resize() function
bug_description:
While reviewing the resize() implementation, I noticed a spelling mistake in the variable name **uninitalized_val**. It should be **uninitialized_val** (note the correct spelling of “initial”).

This typo occurs in multiple places within the function, which can lead to reduced code readability and potential confusion for contributors.

File: torch/_inductor/lowering.py
Function: resize(x, size, *, memory_format=None) 

Steps to reproduce:
N/A — this is not a runtime bug but a minor code quality issue.

Suggested Fix:
Rename all occurrences of uninitalized_val to uninitialized_val for consistency and clarity.

Benefit:
Improves code readability and maintains consistency in variable naming.

Thanks in Advance, I will raise a PR for the same correction!
